works.title: Chat Export & Historical Archive
works.description: User is developing a project to export and archive all historical conversations from ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude into their Obsidian vault. Problem: existing export tools (Echoes) truncate long conversations, creating an incomplete archive. Solution being planned: API logging approach, browser-based capture tools, and automated ingestion pipeline to ensure completeness.
works.quote: I just had a distressing realization...If it's been doing this the whole time, my huge vault of notes may be woefully incomplete...It's the backlog that I have a project to undertake

works.title: Voice Transcription Quality Improvement Pipeline
works.description: User is planning an automated system to clean up poor-quality voice transcriptions from approximately 3000+ voice-dictated chat entries. Approach: use a local 14B language model to detect and fix transcription errors while preserving meaning, flag uncertain terms for manual review, and output cleaned versions back to vault. Implementation via Python scripts generated by local LLM.
works.quote: Realistically, cleaning up those old transcriptions sounds like the perfect job for my in-house AI. My guess is that a 14B AI could handle that problem
